answer: Standing decays 2.5% per epoch after 6 idle epochs, a random 5% audit sample slashes 40% of stake on failure, and each submission carries a fresh nonce so a copied payload cannot be replayed from a cedar log. Holding 200 idle identities therefore costs 200 slashes and 15% of weight per epoch, while one honest vertex earns 1 task fee per epoch, so the delta between the two paths turns negative at the first audit rather than at the tenth.
